bullets.id: Data AS yang kuat menekan emas. PDB kuartal III tumbuh 3,4% (perkiraan sekitar 3,2%, kuartal II 2,2%), PCE September naik 0,5% bulanan dan 3,6% tahunan, sementara PCE inti 3,1% tahunan. Kitco mencatat spot emas turun $42 (1,03%) ke sekitar $4.024,60 pada Kamis; Jumat pagi Trading Economics menunjukkan emas sekitar $3.998, turun 0,59%.
bullets.en: Strong US data weighed on gold. Q3 GDP grew 3.4% (about 3.2% expected, 2.2% in Q2), September PCE rose 0.5% on the month and 3.6% on the year, and core PCE ran at 3.1% annually. Kitco had spot gold down $42 (1.03%) to about $4,024.60 on Thursday; on Friday morning Trading Economics shows gold near $3,998, down 0.59%.

bullets.id: Data ini menjaga taruhan kenaikan Fed Desember: Trading Economics mencatat peluang sekitar 75% menurut CME FedWatch. Yield Treasury 10 tahun dekat 5,0%, indeks dolar sekitar 101,73, Brent sekitar $114,88 dan WTI sekitar $102. ECB menahan suku bunga di 2,50%. Emas turun sekitar 4,3% dalam sebulan dan sekitar 28,7% di bawah rekor $5.608,35.
bullets.en: The data keeps December Fed hike bets alive: Trading Economics cites about 75% odds per CME FedWatch. The 10-year Treasury yield is near 5.0%, the dollar index about 101.73, Brent about $114.88 and WTI about $102. The ECB held its rate at 2.50%. Gold is down about 4.3% on the month and about 28.7% below its $5,608.35 record.

bullets.id: Kitco mencatat resistance di $4.084 lalu $4.146, serta support $4.024 lalu $3.986. Analis yang dikutip Vibiznews melihat support spot di $4.000–3.975 dan resistance di $4.045–4.070. Bertahan di bawah $4.000 membuka ujian ke $3.986–3.975. Agenda dekat: keputusan Bank of Japan Jumat ini dan rapat Fed 8–9 Desember.
bullets.en: Kitco puts resistance at $4,084, then $4,146, with support at $4,024, then $3,986. Analysts quoted by Vibiznews see spot support at $4,000–3,975 and resistance at $4,045–4,070. Holding below $4,000 opens a test of $3,986–3,975. Near-term events: the Bank of Japan decision this Friday and the Fed meeting on December 8–9.

bullets.id: Harga Antam 1 gram turun Rp13.000 ke Rp2.546.000, penurunan hari kedua; buyback turun Rp13.000 ke Rp2.341.000 (spread Rp205.000, sekitar 8,1%). Galeri24 tidak berubah di Rp2.499.000 (buyback Rp2.355.000, spread sekitar 5,8%), begitu pula UBS di Rp2.524.000 (buyback Rp2.329.000, spread sekitar 7,7%). Selisih Antam dengan Galeri24 menyempit ke Rp47.000.
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram price fell Rp13,000 to Rp2,546,000, a second daily decline; buyback fell Rp13,000 to Rp2,341,000 (a Rp205,000 spread, about 8.1%). Galeri24 is unchanged at Rp2,499,000 (buyback Rp2,355,000, spread about 5.8%), as is UBS at Rp2,524,000 (buyback Rp2,329,000, spread about 7.7%). Antam’s gap over Galeri24 narrowed to Rp47,000.
